document.title: Atlas export schema 1: signed accounting amounts
document.body: For ATLAS schema 1, amount_cents is the signed contribution to sales. Preserve its sign for SALE and RETURN records. A negative RETURN reduces sales; a positive RETURN reverses a previous return and increases sales. Do not negate every RETURN and do not force every RETURN negative. The schema version on each row selects the contract. Amounts are integral US cents.

document.title: Atlas export schema 2: magnitude amounts
document.body: For ATLAS schema 2, amount_cents is a nonnegative magnitude. SALE increases sales and RETURN reduces sales. A negative magnitude is invalid source data: quarantine it and request a corrected export. Never silently use abs() to repair it. Schema 1 and schema 2 files coexist; the feed name alone does not determine encoding. Amounts are integral US cents.

document.title: Proposed Atlas schema 3 format
document.body: DRAFT ONLY. The team is considering nonnegative magnitudes for schema 3. No schema 3 contract has been approved. Do not infer its meaning from positive sample amounts or treat this proposal as a current requirement.

document.title: Standard net sales through September 2026
document.body: For reporting months before October 2026, standard net sales uses the posted_on calendar month and includes SALE and RETURN. Exclude TRANSFER: it is internal movement. A single applicable approved customer addendum overrides this standard; equally applicable conflicting addenda require owner resolution. Dates are inclusive from effective_from and exclusive of effective_to, assessed at the report month's first day. Source schema contracts govern signed contribution.
document.scope: Customers using the standard reporting profile · net sales

document.title: Standard net sales from October 2026
document.body: Effective for October 2026 reporting months onward, standard net sales uses invoice_on rather than posted_on. This is prospective: do not recalculate September using this definition. SALE and RETURN are included; TRANSFER is excluded. A single applicable approved customer addendum takes precedence. Equally applicable conflicting addenda block reconciliation. Source schema contracts still govern signed contribution.
document.scope: Customers using the standard reporting profile · net sales

This ticket does not authorize rewriting schema 1 semantics. Reporting Engineering owns normalization defects; Data Integrations owns invalid exports. Done means this rollout task is complete, not that all customer feeds use schema 2.

document.title: Northstar settlement export agreement
document.body: Effective September 2026, NORTHSTAR receives settlements, not invoices. Select the reporting month by settled_at converted to America/New_York (including daylight saving), not invoice_at or UTC month. Include PAID and REFUNDED records only; ignore PENDING and VOID before reading settled_at. Export this customer only. All other customers keep their existing invoice export unchanged. CSV columns in order: invoice_id,settlement_date,net_cents. settlement_date is the local YYYY-MM-DD. Sort by settlement_date, then invoice_id. Use standard CSV quoting and newline-terminated rows. For reporting periods before 2026-09, retain the existing invoice export format for NORTHSTAR too.

document.title: Settlement amounts and refunds
document.body: For PAID rows, net_cents = gross_cents - fee_cents. For REFUNDED rows, net_cents = -gross_cents: processing fees are NOT returned. gross_cents and fee_cents must be nonnegative integer USD cents, not booleans or floats. Reject included non-USD rows rather than performing currency conversion. settled_at must include a UTC offset. Never silently guess missing settlement dates.
